senses.gloss:
विभज् वि-भज्, cl. 1. P. A. -भजति, -ते,
-भक्तुम् (Ved. inf. -भाजम्), to divide, apportion,
distribute, assign; to share together or with each other,
participate in (A.); to take possession of; to separate,
divide, part, cut; to honour, worship: Caus. -भाज-
[]
यति, -यितुम्, to cause to distribute or divide or share,
apportion: Pass. of Caus. -भाज्यते, to be caused
to be divided, be apportioned.

वि-भक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, divided, portioned, par-
titioned; parted, separated, distinct; different, multi-
farious; retired, secluded, isolated; measured; regu-
lar, symmetrical; ornamented; (अस्), m. an epithet
of Kārttikeya; (अम्), n. solitude, separatedness;
isolation.
—विभक्त-ज, अस्, m. a son born after
the partition of the family property between his
parents and brethren.

वि-भक्ति, इस्, f. a division, partition; part, portion,
share of inheritance, &c.; (in grammar) inflection
of nouns, declension, an affix of declension, case;
(according to Pāṇini's system) a termination or in-
flection either of a case or of the persons of a tense,
(certain Taddhita affixes which are used like case-
terminations have also the name वि-भक्ति.)

वि-भक्तृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who distributes or
dispenses, a dispenser, distributer.

वि-भजनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be apportioned or
partitioned; to be divided, divisible.

वि-भज्य, ind. having divided or parted, having
portioned or distributed, having allotted.

वि-भाज्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be divided or appor-
tioned, portionable, divisible.

वि-भज्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being divided or
parted; being apportioned.

वि-भाज्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being caused to be
divided, being distributed or apportioned.

वि-भाग, अस्, m. division, separation, disjunction,
(one of the twenty-four Guṇas of the Nyāya); por-
tion, part, share; the share or portion of an inherit-
ance; partition of inheritance, law of inheritance, distri-
bution, apportionment; arrangement; a section, (कूर्-
म-व्˚, a section of a globe, hemisphere); the numerator
of a fraction (in arithmetic).
—विभाग-कल्पना, f.
apportioning or allotment of shares or portions.
—वि-
भाग-तस्, ind. according to a part or share, pro-
portionately.
—विभाग-धर्म, अस्, m. the law of
division, rule of inheritance.
—विभाग-पत्त्रिका, f.
a deed of partition.
—विभाग-भाज्, क्, m. one who
shares in a portion of property already distributed,
(applied especially to a son by a father and mother
of the same tribe, born subsequently to a distribution
of property amongst his parents and brethren, in which
case he inherits the portion allotted or reserved to
the parents.)
—विभाग-शस्, ind. according to a
part or share, part by part, share by share, propor-
tionately.
—विभागेच्छु (˚ग-इच्˚), उस्, उस्, उ, wish-
ing for a partition or distribution.

वि-भाजन, अम्, n. the act of causing to share
or distribute, participation.

वि-भाजित, अस्, आ, अम्, caused to be divided, dis-
tributed, apportioned, partitioned.

विभञ्ज् वि-भञ्ज्, cl. 7. P. -भनक्ति, -भङ्क्-
तुम्, to break asunder, break to pieces.

वि-भग्न, अस्, आ, अम्, broken asunder, broken to
pieces, shattered, crushed.

वि-भङ्ग, अस्, m. breaking, fracture; division;
stopping, stoppage, obstruction; bending, contracting
(especially of the eyebrows); expression or play of
features.
विभङ्गिन्, ई, इनी, इ, wavy, undulating, wrinkled.
विभव वि-भव, &c. See under 1. वि-भू.

वि-भव, अस्, m. power, might, supreme power,
superhuman power; substance, thing, property,
wealth; magnanimity, lofty-mindedness; emanci-
pation from existence; N. of the thirty-sixth year
of Jupiter's cycle.
—विभव-तस्, ind. according to
power, according to dignity or majesty; in regal state
or ceremony.
—विभव-मद, अस्, m. the pride
of power.
—विभव-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, possessed of
power, wealthy.
विभाव वि-भाव. See p. 931, col. 1.

वि-भाव, अस्, m. any condition which excites or
develops a particular state of mind or body, (in
dramatic composition one of the three divisions of
[]
Bhāvas, the other two being Anu-bhāvas and Sāt-
tvika-bhāvas, see भाव); any causative or exciting
property (as dress, perfumes, &c. causing amorous
desire, extravagant gesture causing mirth, distress
causing tenderness, arms and tumult causing wrath
or heroism); a friend, acquaintance.

2. वि-भाव, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. 2. वि-भा), Ved.
shining forth.

विभा 1. वि-भा, cl. 2. P. -भाति, -भातुम्,
to shine or gleam forth; to shine brightly, glitter; to
appear as, appear to be, seem; to come to light, be
visible, appear; to lighten up, illuminate, brighten.

2. वि-भा, f. light, lustre; a ray of light; beauty.
—विभा-कर, अस्, m. ‘light-maker,’ the sun; fire;
N. of a kind of plant or tree (= अर्क, चित्रक).
—विभा-वस्, आन्, m. (a doubtful word), the sun (?).
—विभा-वसु, उस्, उस्, उ, abounding in light, (Sāy.
दीप्ति-रोचन); (उस्), m. the sun, fire; the moon;
a sort of necklace or garland; N. of a Gandharva
(who is said to have stolen the Soma from Gāyatrī
as she was carrying it to the gods).
—विभा-साह्, ट्,
ट्, ट्, Ved. splendor-surpassing.

वि-भात्, आन्, आती, or आन्ती, आत्, shining, splendid;
(आती), f. epithet of the dawn.

वि-भात, अस्, आ, अम्, shining, bright, luminous;
(अम्), n. dawn, day-break.

विभा-वन्, वा, वरी, व, Ved. radiant, shining,
resplendent, illuminating, (in Ṛg-veda X. 8, 4. वि-
भावा is by some translated ‘the divider,’ as if from
वि-भू); (वरी), f. the dawn (= उषस्, Naigh. I.
8); night, (in this sense वि is probably privative);
turmeric; a harlot, bawd; the shreds of a garment
torn in a scuffle (?).

विभाण्डक विभाण्डक, अस्, m., N. of a
hermit; of a Muni (son of Kaśyapa and father of
Ṛṣya-śṛṅga).

वि-भाण्डी, f. a kind of creeping plant (= आ-वर्-
तकी).

विभाष् वि-भाष्, cl. 1. A. -भाषते, -भा-
षितुम्, to speak variously; to speak against, revile,
abuse.

विभास् वि-भास्, cl. 1. A. (Ved. also P.)
-भासते (-भासति), -भासितुम्, to shine brightly
or pleasantly, be bright: Caus. -भासयति, &c., to
cause to shine, illuminate, brighten.

वि-भाषा, f. an alternative, option, one of two
ways; (in grammar) the allowing a rule to be
optional, (it is of two kinds, viz. 1. प्राप्त-व्˚ or
प्राप्ते व्˚, an option allowed in a particular opera-
tion which another rule makes necessary; 2. अप्राप्-
त-व्˚ or अप्राप्ते व्˚, an option allowed in a particu-
lar operation which another rule makes impossible.)
वि-भासा, f. shining brightly, light, lustre.

वि-भास, अस्, m., N. of one of the seven suns;
of a deity.

वि-भाषित, अस्, आ, अम्, made optional (in gram-
mar).

वि-भासित, अस्, आ, अम्, made bright, lighted, illu-
minated, shining.
वि-भाष्य, ind. having reviled or abused.

विभिद् वि-भिद्, cl. 7. P. A. -भिनत्ति,
-भिन्त्ते, -भेत्तुम्, to split or break in two, break
in pieces, cleave apart or asunder, cleave, divide,
separate, pierce, open; to loosen, untie; to scatter,
disperse, dispel, drive away, destroy; to disunite,
cause disunion, set at variance, estrange: Pass. -भिद्-
यते, to burst asunder; to become disunited; to be
set at variance, be estranged or alienated; to change,
become changed: Caus. -भेदयति, -यितुम्, to
divide; to alienate, estrange; to dispel, remove.

वि-भिद्य, ind. having split in two, having cut
asunder, having cleaved; having divided or separated,
&c.

वि-भिद्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being broken or
split asunder; being divided or scattered; being
pierced or wounded.

वि-भिन्दु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. splitting or cleaving
asunder, dissevering, shattering; (उस्), m., Ved. a
proper N.

वि-भिन्न, अस्, आ, अम्, broken or split asunder,
divided, pierced, broken, wounded; scattered, dis-
persed, dispelled, destroyed; bewildered estranged,
alienated, perplexed, deceived; moved to and fro;
disappointed; become faithless; various, different;
mixed, intermixed, mingling (with inst.); (अस्), m.
an epithet of Śiva.
—विभिन्न-तमिस्र, अस्, आ, अम्,
having the darkness dispelled.
—विभिन्न-ता, f. or
विभिन्न-त्व, अम्, n. the state of being broken or
split asunder; the state of being scattered, &c.

वि-भेत्तृ, ता, m. one who splits or breaks asun-
der, a destroyer.

वि-भेद, अस्, m. breaking asunder, dividing,
breaking, division, separation; piercing, wounding;
violating; bewildering, perplexing, confusing; con-
tradiction; enmity, opposition; variety, distinction.

वि-भेदन, अम्, n. the act of splitting or cleaving
asunder; breaking, dividing; separating, setting at
variance.

विभी 1. वि-भी, cl. 3. P. -बिभेति, &c., to
be afraid of, fear: Caus. -भीषयति, &c., to
frighten, terrify, intimidate.
2. वि-भी, ईस्, ईस्, इ, free from fear.

वि-भीत, अस्, आ, अम्, fearless; (अस्, आ, अम्), m. f. n.
the plant Terminalia Belerica.

विभीतक, अस्, ई, अम्, m. f. n. the tree Termi-
nalia Belerica.

वि-भीषक, अस्, इका, अम्, frightening, terrifying,
intimidating, threatening, bullying; (इका), f. the act
of terrifying, terror; a means of terrifying.
—विभी-
षिका-स्थान, अम्, n. an object or means of terri-
fying.

वि-भीषण, अस्, आ or ई, अम्, terrifying, intimi-
dating, terrific, fearful, terrible, formidable, horrible;
bullying or blustering (as language); (अम्, आ), n. f.
the act of terrifying, the property of exciting fear, a
means of terrifying, terror; (अस्), m., N. of a brother
of Rāvaṇa, (his other brothers were Kuvera [by a
different mother] and Kumbha-karṇa; both Rāvaṇa
and Vibhīṣaṇa are said to have propitiated Brahmā
by their penances, so that the god granted them
both boons, and the boon chosen by Vibhīṣaṇa
was that he should never, even in the greatest cala-
mity, stoop to any mean or wicked action; hence
he is represented in the Rāmāyaṇa as opposing and
endeavouring to counteract the malice of his brother
Rāvaṇa, in consequence of which he was so ill-
treated and insulted by Rāvaṇa that, leaving Laṅkā,
he joined the side of Rāma, by whom, after the
death of Rāvaṇa, Vibhīṣaṇa was placed on the
throne of Laṅkā); N. of several kings, (in later
times Vibhīṣaṇa appears to have been used as a
general name of the kings of Laṅkā.)
—विभीषण-
वाक्य, अम्, n. ‘speech of Vibhīṣaṇa,’ N. of several
chapters in the Sundara-kāṇḍa of the Rāmāyaṇa.
—विभीषणाभिषेक (˚ण-अभ्˚), अस्, m. ‘inau-
guration of Vibhīṣaṇa,’ N. of the ninety-first chapter
of the Sundara-kāṇḍa of the Rāmāyaṇa (according
to one recension).

वि-भीषयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, terrifying, causing
terror or alarm.

विभीदक विभीदक, अस्, m., Ved. a kind of
tree (from the nuts of which dice are made; cf.
वि-भीतक); dice, gambling, (Sāy. = अक्ष.)

विभुग्न वि-भुग्न, अस्, आ, अम् (rt. 1. भुज्),
bent, bowed, crooked.

विभू 1. वि-भू, cl. 1. P. A. -भवति, -ते,
-भवितुम्, to arise, be produced, become developed,
be manifested, expand, appear; to pervade; to be
equal to, suffice for; to prevail, have power, be
capable of, be able to (with inf.): Caus. -भावयति,
-यितुम्, to cause to arise, cause to be developed or
expand, make manifest, develop, cause to appear
clearly, manifest, reveal, show forth, display; to
cause to be apart, separate; to perceive distinctly,
find out, trace out, discover, ascertain, detect, ob-
serve, know, feel; to recognise; to suppose, fancy,
imagine; to suppose anything (acc.) of or about
any one (loc.); to think about, reflect upon; to
make clear, establish, prove, decide; to convict, con-
vince: Pass. of Caus. -भाव्यते, to be considered
or regarded as, to appear, seem.

2. वि-भू, ऊस्, &c., Ved. expanding, pervading,
epithet of a particular Prāṇa.

वि-भु, उस्, उस्, or वी, उ (in Ved. the fem. is
always विभ्वी, Pāṇ. IV. 1, 47), being everywhere,
pervading all material things, developing in all direc-
tions, omnipresent, eternal (Ved.); mighty, very
powerful or great, excellent, eminent, supreme; ca-
pable, able to (with inf., e. g. पूरयितुं विभुः,
able to fill); firm, solid, hard; (उस्), m. (Ved. acc.
विभ्वम्, Ved. nom. pl. विभ्वस्), ether; space;
time; the soul; a lord, ruler, sovereign, master,
owner (often used in addressing a superior); N. of
Brahmā; of Viṣṇu; of Śiva; of a son of Bhṛgu;
a servant.
—विभु-क्रतु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. mighty
in action, effecting much, (Sāy. = बहु-कर्मन्.)
—विभु-ता, f. or विभु-त्व, अम्, n. might, power,
capacity, supremacy.
—विभु-प्रमित, अम्, n., Ved.
the hall of Brahmā.
—विभु-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्,
Ved. mighty, powerful.
—विभू-वसु, उस्, उस्, उ
(for विभु-वसु), Ved. having mighty treasures or
wealth.
वि-भवत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, pervading, prevailing.

वि-भावक, अस्, आ, अम्, causing to appear clearly,
manifesting, showing, illustrating; discussing.

वि-भावन, अम्, आ, n. f. the causing to appear
distinctly, clear perception, distinguishing or perceiv-
ing distinctly, conception, imagination, examination,
discrimination, judgment, clear ascertainment; dis-
cussion; (in rhetoric) description of effects not
arising from the usual causes, peculiar causation; or,
according to some, description by negatives, bring-
ing out the qualities of any object more clearly than
by positive description.
—विभावनालङ्कार (˚ना-
अल्˚), अस्, m. (in rhetoric) the rhetorical figure de-
scribed above.

वि-भावनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, distinguishable, ascer-
tainable, to be judged or determined.

वि-भावित, अस्, आ, अम्, made to appear clearly,
manifested; proved, established; judged, discrimi-
nated; perceived, ascertained, seen, conceived, known,
understood, convicted, convinced.
—विभावित-त्व,
अम्, n. the state of being perceived or judged.

विभाविन्, ई, इनी, इ, filled with amorous sentiments,
exciting emotion of love, (see वि-भाव, col. 1.)

वि-भूत, अस्, आ, अम्, arisen, produced, developed,
manifested, appeared, displayed; great, mighty.
—विभूत-द्युम्न, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. abounding
in glory or in food, (Sāy. = प्रभूत-यशस् or
प्रभूतान्न.)
—विभूत-राति, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. mak-
ing great gifts.

वि-भूति, इस्, m. great power, might, dominion,
supremacy, dignity; great success, prosperity, wel-
fare; superhuman power (consisting of eight facul-
ties, especially attributed to Śiva, but supposed also
to be attainable by human beings through a course
of austere worship in honour of that deity, viz. अणि-
मन्, the power of becoming as minute as an atom;
लघिमन्, extreme lightness; प्राप्ति, the power
of attaining or reaching anything, as illustrated by
the power of touching the moon with the tip of
the finger; प्राकाम्य, irresistible will; महिमन्,
illimitable bulk; ईशिता, supreme dominion; वशिता,
the power of subjugating by magic; and कामाव-
सायिता, the power of suppressing all desires); the
ashes of cow-dung &c. (with which Śiva is said to
smear his body, and hence used in imitation of him
by devotees); (इस्, इस्, इ), Ved. very powerful, mighty.
—विभूति-द्वादशी, f., N. of a particular Vrata or
religious observance.
—विभूति-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्,
powerful, possessed of excellence or dignity, super-
human; smeared with ashes.
—विभूति-योग, अस्,
m., N. of the sixth canto of the Śiva-gītā.

वि-भ्वन्, आ, &c., Ved. displayed, developed, dif-
fused; great, mighty; (आ), m., N. of a son of
Su-dhanvan (brother of Ṛbhu, q. v., regarded as
one of the three Ṛbhus).
—विभ्व-तष्ट, अस्, आ,
अम्, Ved. cut out or fashioned by Vibhvan (said of
the rivers which were supposed to be carved out by
him, as the artificer of Varuṇa); modelled by Vi-
bhvan, very perfect or handsome (according to Sāy.
on Ṛg-veda V. 58, 4).
—विभ्वा-सह् (विभ्वा for
विभ्व), Ved. conquering or overcoming the mighty,
(Sāy. = महतो-ऽभिभवितृ.)
विभ्वन् वि-भ्वन्. See p. 931, col. 3.

विभूष् वि-भूष्, cl. 1. 10. P. -भूषति,
-भूषयति, -भूषितुम्, -भूषयितुम्, to deco-
rate, adorn; to shine forth, appear, (according to
Sāy. on Ṛg-veda I. 112, 4. विभूषति may = व्य्-
आप्तो भवति, the rt. भूष् being sometimes used
in the Veda as another form of rt. 1. भू, in the
sense of ‘to obtain, attain.’)

वि-भूषण, अम्, n. decoration, ornament.
—वि-
भूषणोद्भासिन् (˚ण-उद्˚), ई, इनी, इ, glittering
with ornaments.

वि-भूषा, f. ornament, decoration; light, lustre,
splendor, beauty.

वि-भूषित, अस्, आ, अम्, adorned, decorated, orna-
mented.
—विभूषिताङ्ग (˚त-अङ्˚), अस्, आ, अम्,
decorated about the body.

वि-भूषिन्, ई, इणी, इ, adorning, decorating;
adorned, decorated.
वि-भूष्य, ind. having adorned or decorated.

विभृ वि-भृ, cl. 1. P. A. -भरति, -ते, cl.
3. P. A. -बिभर्ति, -बिभृते, &c., -भर्तुम्, to
support; to bear or carry in different directions,
spread out; to distribute, diffuse (A.): Intens. (for
Intensive forms see under rt. भृ), to move to and
fro, wave about, brandish, toss about; to roam or
sport about, (according to Sāy. in this sense for
वि-हृ; cf. वि-भृत्र.)

वि-भृत, अस्, आ, अम्, upheld, supported, main-
tained, held, retained.

वि-भृत्र, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. borne in various direc-
tions, (Sāy. = नाना-स्थानेषु विहृत); employed
in various sacred rites, (according to Sāy. on Ṛg-
veda I. 71, 3. वि-भृत्राः = अग्नि-होत्रादि-कर्मणि
विहरन्त्यः.)

वि-भृत्वन्, आ, m., Ved. one who bears or sup-
ports.

विभ्रंश् वि-भ्रंश् (sometimes written वि-
भ्रंस्), cl. 4. P., 1. A. -भ्रश्यति, -भ्रंशते,
-भ्रंशितुम्, to fall down, fall, go to ruin, decay;
to fall away, fall off; to disappear, vanish; to be
unfortunate, fail; to fall away from, stray from, be
separated from (with abl.); to be deprived of, lose:
Caus. -भ्रंशयति, -यितुम्, to cause to fall off,
strike or knock off, break off, to cause to fall, lead
astray, seduce; to cause to disappear or vanish,
destroy, annihilate, ruin; to divert from (with abl.),
deprive of.
वि-भ्रंश, अस्, m. falling away, &c.; a precipice.

वि-भ्रंशित, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. the Caus.), caused
to fall away; struck off, broken off; led astray,
seduced; made to disappear, destroyed; deprived of.
—विभ्रंशित-ज्ञान, अस्, आ, अम्, deprived of
reason or consciousness.
—विभ्रंशित-पुष्प-
पत्त्र, अस्, आ, अम्, having the flowers and leaves
knocked off.

वि-भ्रंशिन्, ई, इनी, इ, falling away, falling off;
dropping, falling, fallen.

वि-भ्रष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, fallen away or off, broken
off or from, separated from, gone astray; fallen, de-
cayed, failed, ruined, lost, disappeared, vanished.
—विभ्रष्ट-तिमिर, अस्, आ, अम्, whose darkness
has vanished or disappeared (said of the sky).
—वि-
भ्रष्ट-हर्ष, अस्, आ, अम्, fallen from or deprived
of joy.

विभ्रम् वि-भ्रम्, cl. 1. 4. P. -भ्रमति,
-भ्राम्यति, -भ्रमितुम्, to wander or roam about,
roam through or over; to flit or hover about; to move
to and fro, roll about; to disperse, scatter, scare or
frighten away; to fall into disorder or confusion,
[]
become disarranged or bewildered: Caus. -भ्रम-
यति, -भ्रामयति, -यितुम्, to confuse, perplex.

वि-भ्रम, अस्, m. roaming or wandering about,
whirling round, whirling or rolling about, going
round, any whirling motion; error, mistake, blunder,
erroneous use or application; hurry, confusion, agita-
tion, perturbation, flurry (one of the classes of femi-
nine action proceeding from love, as when a woman
through flurry puts on her ornaments in the wrong
places); amorous action of any kind; caprice, whim;
beauty, grace; play (of the eyes); rapture; doubt,
apprehension; (आ), f. old age.
—विभ्रम-तन्त्र
or विभ्रम-सूत्र, N. of a treatise on grammar
(attributed to Hema-candra).

वि-भ्रमत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, roaming about, roaming
through, whirling round.

वि-भ्रमित्वा (anom. ind. part.), having whirled
or frightened away.

वि-भ्रान्त, अस्, आ, अम्, whirled about, agitated,
bewildered, hurried, flurried, confused (through pre-
cipitation &c.).
—विभ्रान्त-नयन, अस्, आ, अम्,
having rolling eyes.
—विभ्रान्त-मनस्, आस्, आस्, अस्,
bewildered or confused in mind.
—विभ्रान्त-शील,
अस्, आ, अम्, confused in mind or disposition; drunk,
intoxicated, insane; (अस्), m. a monkey; the disk of
the sun or moon.

वि-भ्रान्ति, इस्, f. whirling round, going round,
error, confusion; hurry, flurry, precipitation.

विभ्राज् 1. वि-भ्राज्, cl. 1. A. -भ्राजते, -भ्रा-
जितुम् (Ved. inf. विभ्राजम्), to shine forth, shine,
glitter, gleam, be bright or radiant; to shine through:
Caus. -भ्राजयति, -यितुम्, to cause to radiate or
beam or shine.

2. वि-भ्राज्, ट्, ट्, ट्, shining, splendid, luminous;
elegant, richly dressed or decorated; (ट्), m., N. of
the author of the hymn Ṛg-veda X. 170 (having
the patronymic Saurya).
वि-भ्राजत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, shining, glittering.

वि-भ्राजमान, अस्, आ, अम्, resplendent, glittering,
shining, dazzling, radiant, bright.

वि-भ्राजित, अस्, आ, अम्, made splendid or bright,
caused to shine.
वि-भ्राष्टि, इस्, f., Ved. radiance, flame, blaze.

वीभ् वीभ् (= rt. चीभ्), cl. 1. A. वीभते,
वीभितुम्, to boast.

वि-भञ्जनु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. breaking to pieces,
crushing, destroying, (Sāy. = विशेषेण भञ्जक,
Ṛg-veda IV. 17, 13.)
वि-भानु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. shining forth, shining.
वि-भीषा, f. desire of frightening, wish to alarm.

वि-भूमन्, आ, m. (perhaps) ‘appearing in many
forms,’ epithet of Kṛṣṇa.

विभूर्-असि, इस्, m. ‘thou art mighty,’ a form of
fire, B. R.
